title: centaurea olympica
intro: Centaurea olympica, commonly known as Mountain centaury, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Greece and Turkey. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea olympica include its ability to relax the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used to treat various health conditions.
